1. Load packages
```{r}

# Clean the global environment
rm(list = ls())

# Specify the required packages
X <- c("devtools", "dplyr", "stringdist", "tidyverse", "ggplot2", "apcluster", "soundgen", "parallel", "stringr", "data.table", "tuneR", "pbapply", "warbleR", "magrittr", "infotheo")

# Install the packages in X if not already installed
is_installed <- function(p) is.element(p, installed.packages()[,1])

invisible(lapply(1:length(X), function(x){
  if(!is_installed(X[x])){
    install.packages(X[x], repos = "http://lib.stat.cmu.edu/R/CRAN")
  }
}))

# Install the paRsynth package from GitHub if you haven't installed it already
# devtools::install_github("gsvidaurre/paRsynth")

# Add paRsynth to the list of packages to load
# X <- c(X, "paRsynth")

# Change "Desktop/.../GitHub_repos" based on where paRsynth is stored on your local machine
testing_path_1 <- "~/Desktop/BIRDS/GitHub_repos/paRsynth/R" # Alexandra's testing path
testing_path_2 <- "~/Desktop/BIRDS/GitHub_repos/paRsynth_Info_Cap/Code/" # Alexandra's testing path

# Load the paRsynth function that will be tested below
source(file.path(testing_path_1, "generate_strings.R"))

# Load the custom information theory functions that will be tested below
source(file.path(testing_path_2, "calculate_entropy.R"))
source(file.path(testing_path_2, "detect_duplicates.R"))

# Load all of the packages specified above
invisible(lapply(X, library, character.only = TRUE))

```

2. Set paths and directories
```{r}

# Initialize a base path (this will need to be different per user)
path <- "/Users/gretheljuarez/Desktop/BIRDS/GitHub_repos/paRsynth_Info_Cap/" # Alexandra's path

# Initialize the directory for analysis on your local computer
analysis_dir <- "simulation_experiment_1_data"

# Combine the base path and the newly created data directory into a single path
analysis_path <- file.path(path, analysis_dir)

# Create the data directory if it doesn't already exist on your computer
if(!dir.exists(analysis_path)){ 
  dir.create(analysis_path)
}

edit_dir <- "edit_distance_results"

edit_path <- file.path(path, edit_dir)

if(!dir.exists(edit_path)){ 
  dir.create(edit_path)
}

```

- Calculate the min, 1st quartile, median, mean, 3rd quartile, and the max of the dependent variable of entropy aka information capacity

summary(combined_data)
